text:
rita_sales: Heads up 0- minute thread. Mercury Diagnostics asking for a retroactive volume rebate after a 2-month pilot overspend. They want $32,500 back across three invoices (APR/MAY), saying trial usage should have been covered under a sandbox agreement.

maria_finance: Can you paste the invoices? Need to see charge breakdown and confirm any contractual language about sandbox vs prod. Also flag: >$25k credit needs CFO approval per policy.

paul_saleseng: Quick context - engineering ran a model-refresh during the trial which bumped token consumption. Customer unaware HW test used prod keys. They've signed an MSA but sandbox clause was ambiguous. I have the three invoice IDs: MD-3321, MD-3402, MD-3478.

oscar_revops: Pulled the invoices. Totals: $12,200 (MD-3321), $9,100 (MD-3402), $11,200 (MD-3478) = $32,500. Usage traces show spike originating from a single client_id tied to internal qa-runner. Evidence attached to FIN-8123.

maria_finance: Two options: 1) Full credit $32.5k (high goodwill) 2) Partial credit 75% = $24,375 to avoid precedent and keep within delegation. Which sales can justify revenue upside?

rita_sales: They are a strong strategic prospect; told us they'd move to a 24-month Dedicated commit at $12k/mo if we resolve. If we can make the credit decision today they will execute LOI.

sam_legal: Contract note: MSA has a "sandbox" definition but isn't explicit about keys. Recommend credit memo language: "One-time customer accommodation; not admission of liability; applies solely to invoices MD-3321, MD-3402, MD-3478." Also suggest adding a clarified sandbox addendum for future pilots.

billing-bot: Manual credit threshold rules: credits >$25,000 require CFO approval and must be logged with GL 6110. System will block posting until approved.

elaine_cfo: Thanks for the context. We should avoid habitually crediting full amounts for operational errors. Approve partial credit of $24,375 (75%). Condition: must include signed LOI for 24mo Dedicated and a 15% upfront deposit. Record GL 6110. Legal to draft memo with non-precedent clause.

maria_finance: Approved path noted. I'll prepare credit memo for $24,375 and queue AR adjustment pending LOI + deposit. Tag FIN-8123 on all artifacts.

oscar_revops: I'll add the sandbox addendum template to the SOW library and flag current pilot process to eng.

rita_sales: I'll get LOI + 15% deposit today. Thanks all. :rocket:
